Title: Acquire the Book of Names
ProgressingWorldState: Aspis obtains a means of entering the Book of Names' current holding site.
CompletedWorldState: Aspis takes the Book of Names from its current custodian.

Title: Steal the Offering Chest
ProgressingWorldState: Offerings go missing from the Chest inventory and its custody becomes Contested.
CompletedWorldState: Aspis takes the Offering Chest from its current holder; its gifts cease to be available at Pilgrim's Rest.

Title: Abide
ProgressingWorldState: Cult attendants are admitted to accompany the upcoming Keeper Procession.
CompletedWorldState: Cult attendants occupy the approaches to the House of Abiding and demand custody; a takeover attempt begins.

Title: Connect
ProgressingWorldState: Pilgrim’s Rest can trace surrendered possessions through Claims Registry entries.
CompletedWorldState: Cult controls the Claims Registry; new Cult-related Veiled incursions gain +1 Class.

Title: Reveal
ProgressingWorldState: Pilgrim's Rest prepares an exhibition around reports of the missing resonant object.
CompletedWorldState: The Cult takes the Unclaimed Object from its current holder and exhibits it at Pilgrim's Rest; a Veiled incursion begins around the genuine source.

Title: Understand
ProgressingWorldState: Cult agents prepare to take the Ledger from its current custodian.
CompletedWorldState: The Cult takes the Ledger from its current holder and brings it to Pilgrim's Rest.

Title: Freeze the Civic Improvement Fund
ProgressingWorldState: The Civic Improvement Fund becomes Contested as EGRESS places payments under review; Dawn-funded construction is interrupted.
CompletedWorldState: EGRESS takes control of the Civic Improvement Fund and Dawn-funded work remains halted until refinanced.

Title: Requisition the Specimen
ProgressingWorldState: EGRESS identifies the Unclaimed Object's current holder and issues a scientific containment requisition.
CompletedWorldState: EGRESS takes the Unclaimed Object from its current holder and secures it in Occlusion Containment.

Title: Seize the Stockpiles
ProgressingWorldState: EGRESS locates the Shattered Hidden Stockpiles and begins confiscating them; the network becomes Contested.
CompletedWorldState: EGRESS seizes the Hidden Stockpiles from their current controller.

Title: Break the Shattered
ProgressingWorldState: The Dead Drop Network becomes Contested as Order patrols identify and loot hidden caches.
CompletedWorldState: The Dead Drop Network becomes Damaged; new caches contain loot only on 6 (d6).

Title: Secure the Procession
ProgressingWorldState: Order checkpoints restrict access to the Keeper Procession route.
CompletedWorldState: Armed Order patrols secure all approaches to the Keeper Procession route.

Title: Sunset the Dawn
ProgressingWorldState: A citizen campaign prompts thirty Dawn members to resign (Faction Size −30).
CompletedWorldState: A further forty Dawn members resign (additional Faction Size −40).

Title: Blockade the Procession
ProgressingWorldState: Dawn demonstrators gather along the Keeper Procession route.
CompletedWorldState: A civilian blockade obstructs the Keeper Procession route; its eventual passage remains a matter for play.

Title: Gain Momentum
ProgressingWorldState: Dawn campaign posters appear throughout the Assembly district.
CompletedWorldState: Dawn campaign posters cover public walls and noticeboards across the Colony.

Title: Open the Book of Names
ProgressingWorldState: Dawn agents prepare to take the Book of Names from its current custodian.
CompletedWorldState: Dawn takes the Book of Names and makes it available for public inspection.

Title: Secure the Hall of Keepers
ProgressingWorldState: During Totality, Dawn stewards establish a Contested presence in the Hall of Keepers.
CompletedWorldState: Dawn takes control of the Hall of Keepers, displacing Order administration.

Title: Sunset the Order
ProgressingWorldState: A public hearing on Order authority is scheduled at Assembly Hall; a motion to withdraw recognition is introduced.
CompletedWorldState: Dawn bars Order officials from Assembly Hall unless specifically invited, refusing to recognize their authority inside it.

Title: Break the Lectern
ProgressingWorldState: The Empty Lectern becomes Damaged and is unsafe for remembrance ceremonies.
CompletedWorldState: The Empty Lectern is Destroyed; remembrance ceremonies require another site or lectern.

Title: Silence the Bell
ProgressingWorldState: The Bell of the Sun becomes Damaged and its ringing is unreliable.
CompletedWorldState: The Bell of the Sun is Destroyed; the Order loses its civic alarm.

Title: Steal the Ledger
ProgressingWorldState: Shattered operatives obtain access to the Ledger's current holding site.
CompletedWorldState: The Shattered take the Ledger from its current custodian.

Title: Steal the Unclaimed Object
ProgressingWorldState: Shattered operatives trace the Unclaimed Object to its current holder and prepare a covert theft.
CompletedWorldState: The Shattered steal the Unclaimed Object from its current holder.

Title: Take out the Keeper
ProgressingWorldState: Tavia Rusk begins shadowing Darkwing, looking for access to Vara.
CompletedWorldState: During the next session, Tavia Rusk attempts to assassinate Vara; the attempt does not guarantee her death.

Title: Empty the Reform Treasury
ProgressingWorldState: The Civic Improvement Fund becomes Contested as Witnesses divert a grant toward preservation.
CompletedWorldState: Witnesses take control of the Civic Improvement Fund and redirect its resources toward preservation.

Title: Recover the Unclaimed Object
ProgressingWorldState: Witness recovery notices identify the missing resonant object and offer a reward for its return.
CompletedWorldState: Witnesses take the Unclaimed Object from its current holder and catalog it at the Hall of Remembrance.

Title: Twilight the Dawn
ProgressingWorldState: Witnesses authenticate Assembly records that contradict a claim in Dawn campaign literature.
CompletedWorldState: Witnesses paste corrective broadsides over or beside Dawn posters across the Colony, publishing the contradictory records.
